summary: The first AITY project meeting focused on reviewing and approving the initial Project Plan. Key actions included refining the Figma prototype, finalizing design documentation before coding, expanding the test plan, and clarifying team roles and project deliverables. The plan was officially approved, with a follow-up review meeting scheduled before the next steering group session.
keywords: AITY, Project Plan, Figma prototype, test plan, design documentation
topics: Project Management, Software Development, Quality Assurance
